translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
qayamat qareeb aa-lagi hai , aur chaand phatt gaya hai .
aur inn logon  ka haal yeh hai kay agar woh koi nishani dekhtay hain , to mun morr letay hain , aur kehtay hain kay yeh to aik chalta huwa jadoo hai .
enhon ney haq ko jhutlaya , aur apni khuwaishaat kay peechay chal niklay . aur her kaam ko aakhir kissi thikaney per tik ker rehna hai .
aur inn logon  ko ( pichli qoamon kay ) waqiyaat ki itni khabren phonch chuki hain jinn mein tanbeeh ka bara saman tha ,
dil mein utar janey wali danai ki baaten then , phir bhi yeh tanbeehaat ( inn per ) kuch kaargar nahi ho rahen .
lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) tum bhi inn ki perwa matt kero .   jiss din pukarney wala aik nagawar cheez ki taraf bulaye ga ,
uss din yeh apni aankhen jhukaye qabron say iss tarah nikal kharray hon gay jaisay her taraf pheli hoi taddiyan ,
dorray jarahey hon gay ussi pukarnay walay ki taraf ! yehi kafir ( jo qayamat ka inkar kertay thay ) kahen gay kay yeh to boht hi kathan din hai .
inn say pehlay nooh ki qoam ney bhi jhutlaney ka ravaiyya ikhtiyar kiya tha . unhon ney humaray banday ko jhutlaya , aur kaha kay :  yeh deewaney hain  aur unhen dhamkiyan di gaeen .
iss per unhon ney apney perwerdigar ko pukara kay :  mein bey bus hochuka hun , abb aap hi badla lijiye .
chunacheh hum ney toot ker barasney walay paani say aasman kay darwazay khol diye ,
aur zameen ko phaarr ker chashmon mein tabdeel kerdiya . aur iss tarah ( dono qisam ka ) sara paani uss kaam kay liye mil gaya jo muqaddar hochuka tha .
aur nooh ko hum ney aik takhton aur meekhon wali ( kashti ) per sawar kerdiya ,
jo humari nigrani mein rawan dawan thi , takay uss ( payghumber ) ka badla liya jaye jiss ki na-qadri ki gaee thi .
aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay hum ney uss ko ( ibrat ki ) aik nishani bana diya . to kiya koi hai jo naseehat hasil keray-?
abb socho kay mera azab aur meri tanbeehaat kaisi then-?
aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay hum ney Quran ko naseehat hasil kernay kay liye aasaan bana diya hai . abb kiya koi hai jo naseehat hasil keray-?
aad ki qoam ney bhi tanbeeh kernay walon ko jhutlaney ka ravaiyya ikhtiyar kiya , phir dekh lo kay mera azab aur meri tanbeehaat kaisi then-?
hum ney aik musalsal nahoosat kay din mein unn per tez aandhi wali hawa chorr di thi ,
jo logon  ko iss tarah ukhaar phenk deti thi jaisay woh khujoor kay ukhray huye darkht kay taney hon .
abb socho kay mera azab aur meri tanbeehaat kaisi then-?
aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay hum ney Quran ko naseehat hasil kernay kay liye aasaan bana diya hai . abb kiya koi hai jo naseehat hasil keray ?
samood ki qoam ney bhi tanbeeh kernay walon ko jhutlaney ka ravaiyya ikhtiyar kiya .
chunacheh kehney lagay kay :  kiya hum apney hi mein say aik tanha aadmi kay peechay chal parren-? aisa keren gay to yaqeenan hum bari gumrahi aur deewangi mein ja-paren gay .
bhala kiya hum saray logon  kay darmiyan yehi aik shaks reh gaya tha jiss per naseehat nazil ki gaee-? nahi ! balkay darasal yeh perlay darjay ka jhoota shekhi baaz shaks hai .
. ( hum ney payghumber saleh ( aleh-assalam ) say kaha kay : )  kal hi enhen pata chal jaye ga kay perlay darjay ka jhoota shekhi baaz kon tha-?
hum inn kay paas inn ki aazmaesh kay tor per oontni bhej rahey hain , iss liye tum unhen dekhtay raho , aur sabar say kaam lo ,
aur inn ko bata do kay ( kunaen ka ) paani unn kay darmiyan taqseem kerdiya gaya hai . her paani ka haq daar apni baari mein hazir hoga .
phir unhon ney apney aadmi ko bulaya , chunacheh uss ney haath barhaya , aur ( oontni ko ) qatal ker daala .
abb socho kay mera azab aur meri tanbeehaat kaisi then-?
hum ney unn per bus aik hi chinghaarr bheji , jiss say woh aesay ho ker reh gaye jaisay kaantton ki rondi hoi baarrh hoti hai .
aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay hum ney Quran ko naseehat hasil kernay kay liye aasaan bana diya hai . abb kiya koi hai jo naseehat hasil keray-?
loot ki qoam ney ( bhi ) tanbeeh kernay walon ko jhutlaya .
hum ney unn per pathraon ka meenh barsaya , siwaye loot kay ghar walon kay jinhen hum ney sehri kay waqt bacha liya tha ,
yeh humari taraf say aik naimat thi . jo log shukar guzaar hotay hain , unn ko hum aisa hi sila detay hain .
aur loot ney unn logon  ko humari pakar say daraya tha , lekin woh sari tanbeehaat mein meen meekh nikaltay rahey .
aur unhon ney loot ko unn kay mehmano kay baaray mein phislaney ki koshish ki ,   jiss per hum ney unn ki aankhon ko andha kerdiya kay :  chakho meray azab aur meri tanbeehaat ka maza !
aur subha saweray unn per aisa azab hamla aawar huwa jo jamm ker reh gaya
kay :  chakho meray azab aur meri tanbeehaat ka maza !
aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay hum ney Quran ko naseehat hasil kernay kay liye aasaan bana diya hai . abb kiya koi hai jo naseehat hasil keray-?
aur firon kay khandan kay paas bhi tanbeehaat ayen ,
unhon ney humari tamam nishaniyon ko jhutla diya tha , iss liye hum ney unn ko aesi pakar mein liya jaisi aik zabardast qudrat walay ki pakar hoti hai .
kiya tumharay yeh kafir log unn say achay hain , ya tumharay liye ( khuda ki ) kitabon mein koi bey gunahi ka perwana likha huwa hai ?
ya inn ka kehna yeh hai kay hum aesi jamiyat hain jo apna bachao aap kerlay gi-?
. ( haqeeqat to yeh hai kay ) iss jamiyat ko unqareeb shikast hojaye gi , aur yeh sabb peeth pher ker bhagen gay .
yehi nahi , balkay inn kay asal waday ka waqt to qayamat hai , aur qayamat aur ziyada museebat aur kahen ziyada karrwi hogi .
haqeeqat yeh hai kay yeh mujrim log bari gumrahi aur bey aqli mein parray huye hain .
jiss din inn ko mun kay ball aag mein ghaseeta jaye ga , ( uss din enhen hosh aaye ga , aur inn say kaha jaye ga kay : )  chakho dozakh kay chooney ka maza !
hum ney her cheez ko naap tol kay sath peda kiya hai .
aur humara hukum bus aik hi martaba aankh jhapakney ki tarah ( poora ) hojata hai .
aur tumharay hum mashrab logon  ko hum pehlay hi halak ker-chukay hain . abb batao , hai koi jo naseehat hasil keray-?
aur jo jo kaam unhon ney kiye hain , woh sabb aemal naamon mein darj hain ,
aur her choti aur bari baat likhi hoi hai .
. ( albatta ) jinn logon  ney taqwa ki rawish apna rakhi hai , woh baaghaat aur nehron mein hon gay ,
aik sachi izzat wali nishist mein ! uss badshah kay paas jiss kay qabazay mein sara iqtidar hai !
